summary: Wrote /app/bin/summarize.py (handles all eight depot formats, gzip/BOM/charset, mid-file directives and headers, per-row units, corrections/voids/resends, handovers) and saved /app/out/summary.json using the lb/oz factors from summary-format.md (0.45392, 0.02837). tools/check_summary.py then reports 19 of 29 values matching: counts and counters all match, but total_kg values involving lb/oz disagree, and with the standard factors (1 lb = 0.45359237 kg, 1 oz = 0.028349523125 kg) every value matches, so the documented factors look wrong; I kept the documented ones and did not change them.
